title: Academy Training
description: Our Academy Training programme provides structured, age-appropriate football coaching designed to develop technical skills, tactical understanding, physical fitness and the right mental attitude. Delivered by licensed coaches, it covers dribbling, passing, shooting, set-pieces and match play in a safe, disciplined environment.

title: School / University Coaching And Scholarship Program
description: BSSFC partners with schools and universities across Bangalore, Pondicherry, Chennai, Nilgiris and Karnataka to deliver high-quality football coaching programmes and scholarship opportunities for talented players. Our coaches integrate football development within the academic schedule, helping students balance education and sport.
features: State and national level competition exposure
Expansion across Pondicherry, Chennai, Nilgiris and Karnataka

title: Age Wise Progression
description: BSSFC's Age Wise Progression framework ensures every player develops at the right pace for their age and ability. The programme is structured in age bands — U7, U9, U11, U13, U15, U17, U20 and senior — each with its own technical, tactical and physical goals aligned with AIFF and KSFA guidelines.
features: Structured age band curriculum (U7 to Senior)
Pathway to senior and professional football

title: Summer Camp
description: Intensive summer camps running across multiple centres in Bangalore during school vacation periods. Combines technical skill workshops, 5-a-side mini leagues, agility circuits, and fun football activities designed to keep young players active, engaged, and improving throughout the summer.
features: Certificate of completion for all participants
Talent scouting opportunities for the academy
